recipe_items.title: Prawn, White Bean and Feta Skillet for Two
recipe_items.description: In just under 30 minutes you can deliver a delicious shrimp and bean dinner to the table, and there's only one pan to clean up afterwards.

breadcrumbs.label: Prawn, White Bean and Feta Skillet for Two

recipe_items.title: Roasted Cauliflower Steaks with Raisin Relish
recipe_items.description: The relish is a bold, savoury-sweet combo that works well with mild cauliflower.

breadcrumbs.label: Roasted Cauliflower Steaks with Raisin Relish

recipe_items.title: Papeta par Eda
recipe_items.description: Papeta par eda (eggs over potatoes) can be a breakfast, lunch, dinner or a snack. Sometimes it’s even prepared with crisps instead of chips!

recipe_items.title: 2-Ingredient Bagels
recipe_items.description: These shortcut bagels call for just two ingredients and take less than an hour to come together!

recipe_items.title: Tom Kerridge's Rigatoni with Sausage and Fennel
recipe_items.description: Rigatoni is brilliant for chunky tomato-based sauces as both the hollow tube and the ridges on the outside carry the flavours from plate to mouth.

breadcrumbs.label: Tom Kerridge's Rigatoni with Sausage and Fennel

recipe_items.title: Cherry Polenta Cake
recipe_items.description: Michael Symon's fluffy, rustic cherry polenta cake with sweet cherries and a hint of almond, perfect for dessert or brunch.

recipe_items.title: Crispy Smashed Potatoes with Chimichurri Dressing
recipe_items.description: These Crispy Smashed Potatoes with Chimichurri Dressing feature tender baby potatoes roasted until irresistibly crisp, then topped with a bright, herby chimichurri.

breadcrumbs.label: Crispy Smashed Potatoes with Chimichurri Dressing

episode.title: Episode 7
episode.description: Chef Sophie Grigson shares her new world in beautiful Puglia. From meeting lovely locals to finding delicious ingredients Sophie shows her new Italian life.

season.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice of Italy - Season 2

show.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice of Italy
show.description: Sophie Grigson turned her back on her life in the UK, packed up her car and drove to Southern Italy where she discovers exciting food stories and the hidden delights of Puglia.

show_items.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
show_items.description: Tom invites us inside the kitchens of his Michelin-starred pub, The Coach, where he will reveal the secrets behind great pub food.

show_items.title: Secrets of the Curry Kitchen
show_items.description: Join Chef Asma Khan in her new show, Secrets of the Curry Kitchen, on a journey through the vibrant world of Indian cuisine.

show_items.title: Adam Richman Eats Italy
show_items.description: Globally famous superfoodie Adam Richman is back with his next delicious adventure and this time he's in Italy.

video_items.title: Using Fresh Italian Produce To Make Meatballs Cooked With Red Wine | Sophie Grigson: Slice of Italy
video_items.description: After purchasing produce from the local butchers, Sophie Grigson uses fresh local ingredients for Orecchiette al Primitivo di Manduria, meatballs cooked with good-quality red wine.

video_items.title: Sophie Bakes A Ricotta-Peach Cheesecake With A Prosecco Twist | Sophie Grigson: Slice of Italy
video_items.description: Sophie Grigson bakes an amazing cheesecake with ricotta cheese and peaches, plus a special ingredient that gives the whole dish a twist - Prosecco!

video_items.title: Tom Kerridge Makes Authentic Sticky Baby Back Ribs With Coleslaw | Tom Kerridge Barbecues
video_items.description: Tom takes inspiration from American culture for his BBQ recipes. He makes the authentic sticky baby back ribs with a side of coleslaw.

video_items.title: Tom Cooks A Delicious Middle Eastern Feast With Chicken Kebab And Flatbread | Tom Kerridge Barbecues
video_items.description: Tom Kerridge wants you to improve your barbecue skills! He teaches you how to make a Middle Eastern feast with spicy chicken kebab and cumin flame-grilled flatbread.

blog_items.title: What to Eat (and Drink) in London this Week: 24th August
blog_items.description: New openings, food festivals, chef pop-ups and plenty of Bank Holiday feasting.

blog_items.title: Khao Bird Brings the Heat to The Culpeper
blog_items.description: I clicked in and made a mental note to cancel all existing plans. It's not every day that Khao Bird and The Culpeper come together.

blog_items.title: Where XO Sauce Meets Vinyl: Hausu Review
blog_items.description: From a transformed prawn toast to late-night vinyl sessions, Peckham's Hausu proves that its food is every bit as memorable as its effortlessly cool atmosphere.
